notes.title: Working on My New Game! + Special Discount for Sevyal!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Almost two years ago, I released Sevyal, a game I developed at 15 and published at 16 with zero budget. Now, I’m working on a new game using all the revenue I earned from Sevyal!

I’m currently in the development process, and I’ll be launching the Steam page for my new game soon. I’ll keep sharing updates, so stay tuned!

By the way, Sevyal is currently on sale! Feel free to check it out if you’d like to support me.

Thanks!

notes.title: Our game is full version now!
notes.notes: Our game has been released again. It is currently in full version. We will continue to develop the game. We are looking forward to your feedback.

notes.title: v0.1.3
notes.notes:
- "Back to main menu" button has been added to ESC menu.
- Lighting reworked
- Mental health values ​​have been adjusted.

notes.title: v0.1.2
notes.notes:
- Weight system has been adjusted.
- The sudden turning of the zombie has been fixed.
- Translation errors have been corrected.
- The rate of losing sanity has been readjusted.
- Advantages of items have been fixed.
- Finding the weapon has been made easier.
- Finding repair kits has been made easier.
- Warnings and instructions such as "No repair kit" have been added.
- New fonts have been added to texts for a more stylish appearance.
- Zombie animations have been fixed.
- The difficulty settings of the game have been restructured.

NOTE: It says 0.1.1 in game. My fault. ːsteamsadː

notes.title: V0.1.1
notes.notes:
- Now the battery consumes less energy.
- The battery now provides +100 energy instead of +50.
- The size of the battery and the pill has been increased.
- The creature's pursuit distance has been reduced.
- The flashlight's brightness has been increased.
- The environment has been slightly illuminated.
- Difficulty levels adjusted.
